uncertainties_stated: not stated in the paper's text pages examined
quality_remarks: Osmotic coefficients are stoichiometric (3 particles assumed). Table 1 row T=443.32 K, y=0.35, (0.4905, 1.8944, NaCl 1.5337) looks anomalous (see mapping).
